📱 huamidev/GestaltX (★7,728 · GPL-3.0 · iOS 27.x worse_query Editor v1.0.6)
1. Non-Spoofing AI Flag Toggle vs Hardware Identity Corruption
• Adopts YumEdit 1.2.1 approach: sets generative flag=1 & SiriMode=2 WITHOUT spoofing product/board/CPU
• Prevents Face ID & dictation breakage caused by tools that overwrite hardware identity to US models
2. Kernel-Verified Hardware Identity Recovery & Keychain Plist Proof
Restore HW Identity → Matches CacheData + CacheUUID + cache version vs kernel board/CPU
Supported Matrix → Verifies iPhone 11..15 Plus (incl. SE 2/3); rejects unknown chips
Keychain Proof → Device-bound export verification key stays in device-only Keychain
Shared App Group → Main app + Share Extension dynamically detect signed App Groups
3. Staged Before/After Diff, Typed CacheExtra Editor & 10 Locales
• Automatic initial backup + pre-write backup + verified post-write readback across 9 preset categories
• Rejects missing, incompatible, or already-spoofed backups rather than guessing hardware values
• Supports 10 locales (EN, zh-Hans, zh-Hant-TW/HK, VI, RU, FA RTL, KO, ES, JA)
Architectural Takeaway for AI Solution Architects:
Never allow a configuration editor to restore an imported state snapshot without checking a
device-only Keychain proof or cross-checking CacheUUID and CPU/board identifiers against kernel
truth—and fail closed instead of guessing chip identities.
🛡️ Kianuni/Erosion-CN (★2,124) & kolbicz/WQFiles (★916 · GPL-3.0)
1. Erosion-CN v0.9.1: Anti-Bootloop pwrite + Dynamic libMobileGestalt
• In-place overwrite (pwrite + F_FULLFSYNC) preserves system file inode & ownership (stops reboot revert)
• Zero hardcoded offsets: parses local libMobileGestalt.dylib at runtime to resolve CacheData slots
2. Dual SHA-256 Vaults, Baseband Dual-SIM Coexistence & WQFiles Index
Dual SHA-256 Vaults → App sandbox + persistent system vault survive app uninstall/reinstall
Strict Type Pass → Preserves Boolean vs Float types in Plist (prevents camera black screen)
iOS 27.3b1 Gate → Logs Eligibility no CN region policy on CH/A (server/OS hard block)
WQFiles Fast Index → Queries LaunchServices DB in seconds vs 1-hour full inode fsgetpath scan
3. WQFiles 12-Fixture Host Regression Suite & Container Identity Guard
• WQFiles supports iOS 26.0–27.3b1; refuses backup/clear on (no label) containers lacking verified identity
• ./tests/run_all_tests.sh runs 12 portable Foundation fixtures + ASan (WQ_ASAN=1) before staging IPA
• Erosion-CN documents empty-tray cold-reboot eSIM provisioning for A3715/A3718 dual-SIM + eSIM hardware
Architectural Takeaway for AI Solution Architects:
Atomic temp-file rename changes file inodes and ownership on iOS system caches, causing daemon
rejections or bootloops. Using pwrite + F_FULLFSYNC with runtime dylib symbol resolution and
read-back auto-rollback guarantees bit-exact transactional safety on mobile system files.
